rites.name: Khaigurn
rites.text: Khaigurn is a concept of Ryirleth born in the Singing, the undated sounding when the first roots of the world condensed into form. It holds the shaping pattern that bound the early landfalls together until the Age of Sundering broke those bonds apart.

rites.name: Grimogar
rites.text: Grimogar is a concept of Ryirleth born in the Courts, where divine trials are judged and the doors between worlds are first raised. It is remembered as the principle that a bargain must be paid in full before any passage opens.

rites.name: Voraktok
rites.text: Voraktok is a concept of Ryirleth's Arcane Realm, a crown of braided thorn-iron that a sovereign of the Courts wore while the first doors between worlds were being raised. It is said to hum whenever a council oath is broken, and its wearer could bend a grove's growth to a kingdom's will.

rites.name: Ilotaoma
rites.text: Ilotaoma is the concept of a ritual that binds the ember-choirs of the Holy Age to the doors between worlds, a rite the Courts recognised as the proper seal of each trial. Its practitioners reserved it for the moment a council closed a passage, when its flame was said to hold the door shut.

rites.name: Tharnar
rites.text: Tharnar is a concept of the Weave in Ryirleth, the thread of quiet power that makers plant during the Seeding so the first groves can take root. It is less a being than a principle that the sovereigns of the earliest kingdoms learned to lean upon.

rites.name: Oriilleth
rites.text: Oriilleth is the concept of the Pact as it was sworn over broken worlds in the Fall, binding the scattered Shards into one oath. It is spoken of as a bond that held when landfall tore old loyalties apart during the Age of Sundering.

rites.name: Reolles
rites.text: Reolles is a concept in the Arcane Realm of Ryirleth, shaped during the Walled Age when centuries of holding walls, rival orders, and early churches defined daily life. It is remembered as the principle that a boundary is only as strong as the vows sworn to maintain it, and its first crossings are recorded as the moment those vows were broken.

rites.name: Osuraira
rites.text: Osuraira is a concept of the Arcane realm of Ryirleth, understood in the Walled Age as a binding principle that held cities behind their wards and orders together for centuries. During the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke old oaths, its practitioners were said to bind and unbind whole districts at once.

rites.name: Kaiggaktar
rites.text: Kaiggaktar is a concept of the Walled Age in Ryirleth, when holding walls and sworn orders kept the realm's peoples apart. It names the moment during the Age of Sundering when landfall broke the old bonds and the first crossings began.

rites.name: Draktugurn
rites.text: Draktugurn is a concept held in the Library of Ryirleth, a vast drawing of a wyrm-shaped idea that threads through the branching futures of the Age of Sundering. It is recorded as a force that shapes what the Library chooses to shelve when the ending divides into three.
